source_refs.note: 4. Elastic Collisions: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Molecules ki aapas mein aur deewaron se takkarein poori tarah elastic hain, yani takkar mein kinetic energy bilkul lost (zaya) nahi hoti. Kul kinetic energy wahi rehti hai (conserved).
